preconditioning.notes: Page: can be started manually or automatically by setting a fast-charging station as the navigation destination. Automatic start needs a Toyota Drive Connect trial or subscription.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: the source covers the 2026 bZ's 74.7 kWh pack, not the Woodland by name; Woodland uses the same 74.7 kWh pack (Toyota Canada Woodland release). Toyota chief engineer (via InsideEVs): bZ "still runs on a 400-volt electrical architecture". Autopian: pack 391 V.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Toyota Canada Woodland release: "total capacity of 74.7 kWh" (usable not stated).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: the source covers the 2026 bZ's 74.7 kWh pack, not the Woodland by name; Woodland uses the same 74.7 kWh pack (Toyota Canada Woodland release). Autopian (chief engineer interview): "The larger pack retains the same chemistry and cells as the previous version" (NMC). GreenCars: "still has nickel-manganese-cobalt cathodes". Relayed by press.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: the source covers the 2026 bZ's 74.7 kWh pack, not the Woodland by name; Woodland uses the same 74.7 kWh pack (Toyota Canada Woodland release). InsideEVs relays Toyota: bZ charging "capped at 150 kilowatts". Model-level, not stated per pack.
